# AMW Cooling & Heating, LLC

> Veteran-owned, licensed and insured HVAC contractor serving Conroe, TX and the greater Houston / Montgomery County metro. Founded by Josh (Owner). Open 8am to 9pm, 7 days a week. 5.0-star Google rating. License TACLB133920E. Phone: (936) 331-1339. Email: admin@amwairconditioning.com. Address: 2346 Strong Horse Dr, Conroe, TX 77301.

AMW Cooling & Heating installs, repairs and maintains residential and light-commercial HVAC systems across thirteen Texas service areas. The business is veteran-owned and operated, NATE / EPA 608 trained, and works with all major equipment brands (Trane, Lennox, Carrier, Goodman, Rheem). The website is content-dense: 7 service pages, 13 location pages, and 25+ educational blog posts focused on Texas climate (humidity, summer load, dryer-vent fire prevention, fall furnace prep).

## Services

- [AC Installation](https://amwairconditioning.com/services/ac-installation): Manual J load calc, SEER2 equipment, new and replacement systems.
- [AC Repair](https://amwairconditioning.com/services/ac-repair): Same-day diagnostics, refrigerant leaks, capacitor and compressor failures.
- [Heating Repair and Installation](https://amwairconditioning.com/services/heating-repair): Furnaces, heat pumps, hybrid systems.
- [HVAC Maintenance](https://amwairconditioning.com/services/hvac-maintenance): Annual tune-ups and recurring maintenance plans.
- [Indoor Air Quality](https://amwairconditioning.com/services/indoor-air-quality): Air purifiers, UV lights, ERV / HRV ventilation, filtration upgrades.
- [Smart Thermostats](https://amwairconditioning.com/services/smart-thermostats): Nest, ecobee, Honeywell install and integration.
- [Dryer Vent Cleaning](https://amwairconditioning.com/services/dryer-vent-cleaning): Fire-prevention focused dryer vent service.
